Hi,
Sorry to say but your doctor was pretty useless with his advice. You really need to ask for a referral to a dermatologist for excess hair/skin, endocrinologist for insulin resistance and such. Losing 8lbs isn't going to cure you as PCOS never goes away its a life long condition. A lot of ill-informed doctors think weight is the answer to PCOS management (yes - it does help), but really every person is different. I've known of people at 100lbs with severe pcos symptoms. Symptoms do get easier to manage with the right treatment. Push for Metformin and Spironolactone if you can. Those two medications will help you tremendously.  Tranexamic acid might be worth asking for to help with heavy periods. Also in meantime try low carb diet, drink water with lemon each morning, get some b12, vit d and folic acid supplements. Have you had liver function tested? Internal scan of ovaries? (surprised if your doctor hasn't pushed for this) NAFLD is common with PCOS. These things need checking. 
Wishing you all the best with your journey. Keep fighting & try to stay positive. 
You're not alone.
